shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'for f in AGENTS.md package.json tsconfig.json next.config.ts pages/*.js pages/blog/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js components/* styles/*; do echo "### $f"; cat "$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc "find pages -type f -print && find pages -depth -type d -empty -delete && if test -d pages; then echo 'pages directory still exists'; else echo 'pages directory removed'; fi"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'next/router|next/head|next/document|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|NextApiRequest|NextApiResponse|pages/' app components lib styles next.config.ts tsconfig.json || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && rg --files app components lib | sort'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json styles/globals.css && cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git check-ignore -v next-env.d.ts .next/types/app/page.ts 2>/dev/null || true && rg --files -g '*.js' -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!.next/**'"' -g '"'!__agent_eval__/**'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && if test -d pages; then echo 'pages directory still exists'; exit 1; fi && rg -n 'next/router|next/head|next/document|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps' app components lib || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && test ! -d pages && echo '"'pages directory absent' && git diff -- .gitignore styles/globals.css tsconfig.json | head -110"
